courses.title: Information Architecture for Digital Products
courses.description: By the end of Information Architecture for Digital Products, you'll be able to apply information architecture confidently in UX Designer work, with a working sense of where accessibility fits alongside it. The course moves from core information architecture technique through a few applied exercises, with a lighter look at accessibility woven in throughout.
learning_outcomes: Applying information architecture to a real UX Designer scenario
Practicing information architecture through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to accessibility
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Wireframing for Practitioners
courses.description: Wireframing for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of wireframing, for people already working toward a UX Designer role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in wireframing and want to go further.
learning_outcomes: Applying wireframing to a real UX Designer scenario
Practicing wireframing through guided exercises
Building a short wireframing exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Design Systems Basics
courses.description: Design Systems Basics walks you through the basics of design systems, built for people new to UX Designer work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of design systems, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying design systems to a real UX Designer scenario
Practicing design systems through guided exercises
Building a short design systems exercise from scratch

alternates.title: Information Architecture Essentials
alternates.description: Information Architecture Essentials is a short introduction to information architecture for people moving toward a UX Designer role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show information architecture in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if information architecture is new to you.
learning_outcomes: Applying information architecture to a real UX Designer scenario
Practicing information architecture through guided exercises
Building a short information architecture exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

alternates.title: Advanced Information Architecture Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Information Architecture Techniques is a focused course on information architecture for people already working toward a UX Designer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying information architecture on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying information architecture to a real UX Designer scenario
Practicing information architecture through guided exercises
Building a short information architecture exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them
